title: The Rules of the Ground You Stand On: Power, Rights, and the Systems Around You
author: Intellectual Encounters editorial project

description: A primer on the systems that decide so much of your daily life — what power and legitimacy are, where rights come from and what they actually do, and what it means to have a voice as a newcomer in a democracy.
